response.original_title: [Link-Rooms] How to link rooms on Celebrity Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, Celebrity can help coordinate separate Cruise reservations. You must call ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] Celebrity Cruise and provide both booking numbers when requesting that reservations be linked ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] or noted together. Explain that the guests are travelling together and ask the representative to review the bookings. ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] If you also need connecting cabins, make that request during the same call. Provide both booking numbers when asking Celebrity to associate reservations. Calling ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] customer service also lets you request connecting cabins or other arrangements for your group
